# CANDIDATE: VWAPCONT_STRUCTURE_VETO_PER_SETUP

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Applying the proven structure_veto (block P-in-uptrend / C-in-downtrend) to the vwap_continuation setup will remove wrong-way trades (losers) without affecting winners, improving Sharpe and reducing maxDD while preserving edge_capture on J's anchor days. The veto is already validated globally; scoping it to vwap_continuation isolates its effect on this high-frequency setup.

## Mechanism

For each vwap_continuation signal (Safe and Bold), compute intraday trend using `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` on 5m same-day bars. If signal side is PUT and classified trend is UP, veto the entry. If signal side is CALL and classified trend is DOWN, veto. Otherwise allow entry. The veto is gated by the existing `gate_params["structure_veto_enabled"]` flag (default OFF). This mirrors the global veto from STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND but applies only to vwap_continuation, leaving other setups unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** Full OPRA OOS window 2025-01-02..2026-06-18 (16 months). Selection method: all vwap_continuation signals (Safe and Bold). Overfit risk: low because veto logic is proven on another setup; risk is that vwap_continuation may have different trend-conditioned edge.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will be performed as part of this candidate's A/B test).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will be performed as part of this candidate's A/B test).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: veto incorrectly blocks a winner (e.g., 5/04 PUT winner occurring during a short intraday uptrend). 
   - Max drawdown: could increase if veto removes too many small losers that provide diversification, causing lumpy P&L. 
   - Blow-up scenario: veto triggers on >50% of signals, turning edge negative by removing winners.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will report top5_pct of P&L after test).
